decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing the requested 4-by-4 badge layout; no additional update or removal is needed.
Choosing an eight-badge catalog without the Legend badge does not change the referral milestones, award destination, or on-chain recording rules.
The badge catalog and icon decision does not alter the Small Block prize amount, cadence, eligibility, or funding rules.
The badge catalog decision is unrelated to the deferred Transak fiat-mint flow.
The source Event changes the badge catalog; it does not change the landing-page book-cover placement, size, crop, or visibility.
The number and identity of displayed badges do not change Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, expiration, or accounting semantics.
The badge catalog decision has no effect on seedless wallet creation, custody, access, or fiat-buyer reward storage.
The About page mentions badges only generically and does not expose the Legend badge or catalog count, so its current copy remains valid.
The FAQ describes badge purpose and referral milestones without enumerating the catalog or mentioning the Legend badge.
Changing the badge catalog does not alter dashboard visibility of awarded prize-ticket counts.
The Mission page refers to badges and achievements generically and contains no Legend-specific or badge-count copy requiring revision.
Removing the Legend badge from the approved catalog does not negate the requirement that permanent earned badges remain visible in NFT metadata.
